muyesser-irab:159-159.t: ﴿وإن ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); رب is the noun (ism) of إن, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl); العزيز is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and الرحيم is a second khabar. Or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), العزيز is the khabar of ﴿هو﴾, الرحيم is a second khabar, and the clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:160-160.t: ﴿كذبت قوم لوط المرسلين﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; كذبت is a verb, قوم is the fāʿil (agent), لوط is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and المرسلين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:161-161.t: ﴿إذ قال لهم أخوهم لوط ألا تتقون﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبت﴾; the clause of ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) through the adverb's being annexed to it; ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قال﴾; أخوهم is the fāʿil (agent); لوط is a badal (substitute) from ﴿أخوهم﴾; ألا is a particle of gentle proposal (ʿarḍ); تتقون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:162-162.t: ﴿إني لكم رسول أمين﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya); in ﴿إني﴾, إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and the yāʾ is its noun (ism); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to ﴿رسول﴾; رسول is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and أمين is a naʿt (adjective) of رسول.

muyesser-irab:163-163.t: ﴿فاتقوا الله وأطيعون﴾: the fāʾ is al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); اتقوا is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and ﴿الله﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وأطيعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أطيعون is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the nūn is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya); and the yāʾ, omitted out of regard for the verse endings (fawāṣil), is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:164-164.t:
﴿وما أسألكم عليه من أجر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; أسألكم is an imperfect verb, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a preposition of ṣila (redundant, zāʾida); and أجر is genitive (majrūr) in form and accusative (manṣūb) in position, because it is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إن أجري إلا على رب العالمين﴾: إن is negating; أجري is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿على رب العالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:165-165.t: ﴿أتأتون الذكران من العالمين﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; ﴿تأتون﴾ is an imperfect verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and الذكران is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿من العالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:166-166.t:
﴿وتذرون ما خلق لكم ربكم من أزواجكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; تذرون is conjoined to تأتون, falling within the scope of the rebuking interrogative; it is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); خلق is a past verb; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلق; ربكم is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿خلق لكم ربكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿من أزواجكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), on the view that ﴿من﴾ is explicative (lil-tabyīn); or it is partitive (lil-tabʿīḍ).
﴿بل أنتم قوم عادون﴾: ﴿بل﴾ is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject), قوم is the khabar (predicate), and عادون is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:167-167.t: ﴿قالوا لئن لم تنته يا لوط لتكونن من المخرجين﴾: قالوا is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); in ﴿لئن﴾ the lām paves the way for an oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and إن is conditional; لم is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; ﴿تنته﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾; in ﴿لتكونن﴾ the lām is the one occurring in the response to the oath; ﴿تكونن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and its noun (ism) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); and ﴿من المخرجين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:168-168.t: ﴿قال إني لعملكم من القالين﴾: قال is a past verb; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun (ism); ﴿لعملكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿القالين﴾; ﴿من القالين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of إن; and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). It has also been said: ﴿من القالين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the omitted khabar, i.e. «لقالٍ من القالين» (a hater, one of the haters), and ﴿لعملكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:169-169.t: ﴿رب نجني وأهلي مما يعملون﴾: رب is the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf) to the omitted yāʾ of the first person, and the vocative particle has been omitted from it; نجني is a supplication (duʿāʾ), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أهلي is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), or conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the yāʾ; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نجني﴾; and the clause يعملون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:170-170.t: ﴿فنجيناه وأهله أجمعين﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to an omitted, implied [clause]; نجيناه is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أهله is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), or conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ; and أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis).

muyesser-irab:171-171.t: ﴿إلا عجوزا في الغابرين﴾: إلا is a particle of exception, and عجوزًا is excepted (mustathnā) by إلا; ﴿في الغابرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عجوزًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:172-172.t: ﴿ثم دمرنا الآخرين﴾: ثم is a conjunction; دمرنا is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), and الآخرين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:173-173.t: ﴿وأمطرنا عليهم مطرا فساء مطر المنذرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أمطرنا is conjoined to دمرنا; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أمطرنا﴾; and مطرًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فساء﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ساء is a verb of blame; مطر المنذرين is the fāʿil (agent) of ساء; and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "their rain" (مطرهم).

muyesser-irab:174-174.t:
﴿إن في ذلك لآية﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and ﴿آية﴾ is its postponed noun (ism).
﴿وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating; ﴿كان﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; أكثرهم is its noun (ism), and مؤمنين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:175-175.t: ﴿وإن ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); رب is the noun (ism) of إن, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl); العزيز is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and الرحيم is a second khabar. Or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), العزيز is the khabar of ﴿هو﴾, الرحيم is a second khabar, and the clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:176-176.t: ﴿كذب أصحاب الأيكة المرسلين﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; كذب is a past verb, أصحاب is the fāʿil (agent), الأيكة is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and المرسلين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:177-177.t: ﴿إذ قال لهم شعيب ألا تتقون﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذب﴾; the clause of ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) through the adverb's being annexed to it; قال is a past verb; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قال﴾; شعيب is the fāʿil (agent); ألا is a particle of gentle proposal (ʿarḍ); تتقون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:178-178.t: ﴿إني لكم رسول أمين﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun (ism); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to رسول; رسول is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and أمين is a naʿt (adjective) of رسول.

muyesser-irab:179-179.t: ﴿فاتقوا الله وأطيعون﴾: the fāʾ is al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); اتقوا الله is an imperative verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وأطيعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أطيعون is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the nūn is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya); and the yāʾ, omitted out of regard for the verse endings (fawāṣil), is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:180-180.t:
﴿وما أسألكم عليه من أجر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; أسألكم is an imperfect verb, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a preposition of ṣila (redundant, zāʾida); and أجر is genitive (majrūr) in form and accusative (manṣūb) in position, because it is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إن أجري إلا على رب العالمين﴾: إن is negating; أجري is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿على رب العالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:181-181.t: ﴿أوفوا الكيل ولا تكونوا من المخسرين﴾: أوفوا is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and الكيل is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; ﴿تكونوا﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾; the wāw is its noun (ism); and ﴿من المخسرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:182-182.t: ﴿وزنوا بالقسطاس المستقيم﴾: ﴿زنوا﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿بالقسطاس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿زنوا﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and المستقيم is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:183-183.t:
﴿ولا تبخسوا الناس أشياءهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تبخسوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); الناس is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and أشياءهم is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولا تعثوا في الأرض مفسدين﴾: لا تعثوا is conjoined to ﴿لا تبخسوا﴾; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تعثوا﴾; مفسدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) that reinforces the meaning of the word governing it (ḥāl muʾakkida).

muyesser-irab:184-184.t: ﴿واتقوا الذي خلقكم والجبلة الأولين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and الذي is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿خلقكم﴾ is a past verb, its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause خلقكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. الجبلة is conjoined to ﴿الذي﴾, and الأولين is a naʿt (adjective) of الجبلة.

muyesser-irab:185-185.t: ﴿قالوا إنما أنت من المسحرين﴾: قالوا is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿إنما﴾ is a restraining [ما] and a restrained [إنّ] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); أنت is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من المسحرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:186-186.t:
﴿وما أنت إلا بشر مثلنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; أنت is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); بشر is the khabar (predicate); and مثلنا is a naʿt (adjective) of بشر.
﴿وإن نظنك لمن الكاذبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is lightened from the heavy [إنّ] and inoperative (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla, muhmala); نظنك is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); and ﴿من الكاذبين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿نظنك﴾.

muyesser-irab:187-187.t: ﴿فأسقط علينا كسفا من السماء إن كنت من الصادقين﴾: the fāʾ is al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); أسقط is an imperative verb; ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أسقط﴾; كسفًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كسفًا﴾; إن is conditional; كنت is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun (ism); ﴿من الصادقين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then cause to fall upon us" (فأسقط علينا).

muyesser-irab:188-188.t: ﴿قال ربي أعلم بما تعملون﴾: قال is a past verb; ﴿ربي﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and أعلم is the khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾; ﴿تعملون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:189-189.t:
﴿فكذبوه فأخذهم عذاب يوم الظلة﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كذبوه is a past verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فأخذهم is a past verb, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; and عذاب يوم الظلة is the fāʿil.
﴿إنه كان عذاب يوم عظيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause of كان is its khabar (predicate); the noun of كان is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هو); عذاب is the khabar of كان, يوم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and عظيم is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:190-190.t:
﴿إن في ذلك لآية﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and آية is its postponed noun (ism).
﴿وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; أكثرهم is the noun (ism) of كان, and مؤمنين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:191-191.t: ﴿وإن ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿ربك﴾ is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl); العزيز is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and الرحيم is a second khabar. Or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), العزيز is the khabar of ﴿هو﴾, الرحيم is a second khabar, and the clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:192-192.t: ﴿وإنه لتنزيل رب العالمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; the pronoun refers back to the Quran; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and ﴿تنزيل رب العالمين﴾ is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:193-193.t: ﴿نزل به الروح الأمين﴾: نزل is a past verb; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "accompanied by it" (متلبسًا به), so the bāʾ is of accompaniment (lil-mulābasa); الروح is the fāʿil (agent), and الأمين is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause is a naʿt of تنزيل.

muyesser-irab:194-194.t: ﴿على قلبك لتكون من المنذرين﴾: ﴿على قلبك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نزل﴾; the lām is causal (lil-taʿlīl); ﴿تكون﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿نزل﴾; and ﴿من المنذرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿تكون﴾.

muyesser-irab:195-195.t: ﴿بلسان عربي مبين﴾: ﴿بلسان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿المنذرين﴾, or it is a badal (substitute) from His words ﴿به﴾ with repetition of the governing word, i.e. "it came down in an Arabic tongue" (نزل بلسان عربي); عربي is a naʿt (adjective), and مبين is a second naʿt.

muyesser-irab:196-196.t: ﴿وإنه لفي زبر الأولين﴾: conjoined to what precedes; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and ﴿في زبر الأولين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:197-197.t: ﴿أولم يكن لهم آية أن يعلمه علماء بني إسرائيل﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the wāw conjoins to an implied [clause]; لم is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; ﴿يكن﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿آية﴾ and was placed before it; آية is the fronted khabar (predicate) of يكن; ﴿أن يعلمه﴾ is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the noun (ism) of يكن; and علماء بني إسرائيل is the fāʿil (agent) of يعلمه.

muyesser-irab:198-198.t: ﴿ولو نزلناه على بعض الأعجمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لو is a conditional particle of impossibility (imtināʿiyya); نزلناه is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿على بعض الأعجمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نزلناه﴾.

muyesser-irab:199-199.t:
﴿فقرأه عليهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; قرأه is a past verb, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) referring back to ﴿بعض الأعجمين﴾, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قرأه﴾.
﴿ما كانوا به مؤمنين﴾: ما is negating; كانوا is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the wāw is its noun (ism); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مؤمنين; ﴿مؤمنين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا; and the clause ﴿ما كانوا به مؤمنين﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:200-200.t: ﴿كذلك سلكناه في قلوب المجرمين﴾: in ﴿كذلك﴾, the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a naʿt (adjective) of an implied maṣdar (verbal noun) that emphasizes an omitted verb; the implied sense of the speech is «سلكناه سلكًا مثل هذا السلك البديع المذكور» (We made it enter, an entering like this wondrous entering that has been mentioned), i.e. We made the Quran enter the hearts of the criminals, so they understood its meanings and recognized its eloquence. In ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿سلكناه﴾ is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿في قلوب المجرمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سلكناه﴾.

muyesser-irab:201-201.t: ﴿لا يؤمنون به حتى يروا العذاب الأليم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) from the hāʾ in ﴿سلكناه﴾; or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from المجرمين. لا is negating; يؤمنون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمنون﴾; حتى is a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive; يروا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by ﴿حتى﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يؤمنون﴾; the wāw in ﴿يروا﴾ is the fāʿil; العذاب is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الأليم is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:202-202.t:
﴿فيأتيهم بغتة﴾: the fāʾ is a particle of immediate sequence (taʿqīb); يأتيهم is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and it is conjoined to يروا; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو); the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and بغتة is a ḥāl (circumstantial). [Translator's note: the source calls يأتيهم nominative while also making it conjoined to the accusative يروا; in the Quranic text it is فَيَأْتِيَهُمْ, accusative, and the next entry treats the following يقولوا as accusative by conjunction to it. Translated as written.]
﴿وهم لا يشعرون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause لا يشعرون is the khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:203-203.t: ﴿فيقولوا هل نحن منظرون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; يقولوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to يأتيهم, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); هل is an interrogative particle whose meaning is lament (taḥassur); نحن is the mubtadaʾ (subject), منظرون is the khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:204-204.t: ﴿أفبعذابنا يستعجلون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the fāʾ conjoins to an implied [clause] that the context calls for, the implied form being «أيغفلون عن ذلك مع تحققه وتقرره فيستعجلون؟» (Are they heedless of that, despite its being certain and established, and so they seek to hasten [it]?); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستعجلون﴾; يستعجلون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:205-205.t: ﴿أفرأيت إن متعناهم سنين﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; it has also been said that the fāʾ is a conjunction and the clause is conjoined to ﴿يقولوا﴾. رأيت is a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent) of رأيت; إن is conditional; متعناهم is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); سنين is an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿متعناهم﴾; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what stands in place of the two objects of ﴿رأيت﴾, namely His saying (Exalted is He) ﴿ما أغنى عنهم ما كانوا يمتعون﴾, which comes later. The conditional clause in its entirety has no grammatical position, because it is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya).

muyesser-irab:206-206.t: ﴿ثم جاءهم ما كانوا يوعدون﴾: ثم is a conjunction; جاءهم is a past verb, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿ما﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of جاءهم; and the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The wāw is the noun (ism) of كان; يوعدون is an imperfect verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause يوعدون is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿كانوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:207-207.t: ﴿ما أغنى عنهم ما كانوا يمتعون﴾: ما is interrogative, a fronted object of ﴿أغنى﴾, the interrogative being one of disavowal (inkārī) with the meaning of negation; it has also been said that ما is negating. أغنى is a past verb; ﴿عنهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أغنى﴾; and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative [noun] that is the fāʿil (agent), or it is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun-forming), in which case it and what it introduces are interpreted as a maṣdar that is the fāʿil of أغنى.

muyesser-irab:208-208.t: ﴿وما أهلكنا من قرية إلا لها منذرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ما is negating; أهلكنا is a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); من is a preposition of ṣila (redundant, zāʾida); ﴿قرية﴾ is a noun genitive (majrūr) by من in form and accusative (manṣūb) in position, as the object of أهلكنا; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and منذرون is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿قرية﴾, and it has also been said: a naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿وما أهلكنا...﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:209-209.t:
﴿ذكرى﴾: ذكرى is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), the word governing it being ﴿منذرون﴾; or it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «هذه ذكرى» (this is a reminder), in which case the clause is parenthetical, with no grammatical position; or a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «مذكرين» (reminding); or a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿منذرون﴾, either by way of hyperbole, or by way of omission, i.e. «منذرون ذوو ذكرى» (warners possessed of reminder).
﴿وما كنا ظالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿كنا﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism), and ظالمين is the khabar of ﴿كنا﴾. The clause ﴿ما كنا ظالمين﴾ may be conjoined to ﴿ذكرى﴾, i.e. «نذكّركم ولا نظلم» (We remind you and do not wrong), or it may be a ḥāl from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in ﴿ذكرى﴾, because it is like a maṣdar (verbal noun) requiring something to be predicated of.

muyesser-irab:210-210.t: ﴿وما تنزلت به الشياطين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; تنزلت is a past verb; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تنزلت﴾, the pronoun referring to the Quran; and الشياطين is the fāʿil (agent) of تنزلت.

muyesser-irab:211-211.t: ﴿وما ينبغي لهم وما يستطيعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; ينبغي is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring back to the Quran; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينبغي﴾; ﴿وما يستطيعون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما ينبغي﴾; and the object of يستطيعون is omitted, its implied form being "that" (ذلك).

muyesser-irab:212-212.t: ﴿إنهم عن السمع لمعزولون﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), giving the reason for their inability to come down with it; in ﴿إنهم﴾, إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism); ﴿عن السمع﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿معزولون﴾; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and معزولون is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:213-213.t:
﴿فلا تدع مع الله إلها آخر﴾: the fāʾ is al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); لا is prohibitive; تدع is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿مع﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿إلهًا﴾ and was placed before it; إلهًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ﴿آخر﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿إلهًا﴾.
﴿فتكون من المعذبين﴾: the fāʾ is causative (al-fāʾ al-sababiyya); ﴿تكون﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the fāʾ; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. «لا يكن منك دعوة فحصول عذاب لك» (let there be no calling [on another god] from you, and so [no] befalling of punishment upon you); the noun (ism) of تكون is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); and ﴿من المعذبين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of تكون.

muyesser-irab:214-214.t: ﴿وأنذر عشيرتك الأقربين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنذر is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); عشيرتك is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الأقربين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:215-215.t: ﴿واخفض جناحك لمن اتبعك من المؤمنين﴾: likewise conjoined; اخفض is an imperative verb, the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and جناحك is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اخفض﴾; اتبعك is a past verb, the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause اتبعك is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. ﴿من المؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:216-216.t: ﴿فإن عصوك فقل إني بريء مما تعملون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; إن is conditional; عصوك is a past verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verb is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فقل﴾: the fāʾ binds the apodosis (rābiṭa lil-jawāb). In ﴿إني﴾, إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and the yāʾ is its noun (ism); بريء is its khabar (predicate); ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بريء﴾; the clause تعملون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿إني بريء﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:217-217.t: ﴿وتوكل على العزيز الرحيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; توكل is an imperative verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿على العزيز﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿توكل﴾; and ﴿الرحيم﴾ is a naʿt (adjective), and it has also been said: a badal (substitute). [Translator's note: the source calls the imperative "jussive" (majzūm), which is the Kufan view; elsewhere this book describes imperatives as indeclinable (mabnī). Translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:218-218.t: ﴿الذي يراك حين تقوم﴾: الذي is a second naʿt (adjective) of ﴿العزيز﴾; يراك is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause يراك is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. حين is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يراك﴾, and the clause تقوم is genitive (majrūr) through the adverb's being annexed to it; and what ﴿تقوم﴾ is attached to is omitted, i.e. "to the prayer" (إلى الصلاة).

muyesser-irab:219-219.t: ﴿وتقلبك في الساجدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and تقلبك is conjoined to the kāf in يراك; ﴿في الساجدين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:220-220.t: ﴿إنه هو السميع العليم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism); ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and السميع العليم are two khabars (predicates) of ﴿إن﴾; or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), السميع العليم are two khabars of ﴿هو﴾, and the nominal clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:221-221.t: ﴿هل أنبئكم على من تنزل الشياطين﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; هل is an interrogative particle; أنبئكم is an imperfect verb, the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على من﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تنزل﴾; the clause stands in place of the second and third objects; ﴿تنزل﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and الشياطين is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:222-222.t: ﴿تنزل على كل أفاك أثيم﴾: تنزل is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿على كل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تنزل﴾, and it is a badal (substitute) from the preposition and genitive noun before it, ﴿على من﴾; أفاك is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and أثيم is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:223-223.t: ﴿يلقون السمع وأكثرهم كاذبون﴾: يلقون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); it refers back to ﴿الشياطين﴾, in which case the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); or it refers back to ﴿كل أفاك أثيم﴾, in which case the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كل أفاك أثيم﴾. السمع is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is circumstantial; أكثرهم is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and كاذبون is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is circumstantial.

muyesser-irab:224-224.t: ﴿والشعراء يتبعهم الغاوون﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; الشعراء is the mubtadaʾ (subject); يتبعهم is an imperfect verb, the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الغاوون is the postponed fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿يتبعهم﴾ is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:225-225.t: ﴿ألم تر أنهم في كل واد يهيمون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The hamza is for interrogation. لم is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive. ﴿تر﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its being jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); أن and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of ﴿تر﴾; ﴿في كل واد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يهيمون﴾; يهيمون is an imperfect verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أن; or the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted [word] which is the khabar, and the clause يهيمون is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:226-226.t: ﴿وأنهم يقولون ما لا يفعلون﴾: a conjoined clause; in ﴿أنهم﴾, أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism); يقولون is an imperfect verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أن; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative [noun], the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لا﴾ is negating; ﴿يفعلون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; and ﴿لا يفعلون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:227-227.t:
﴿إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات وذكروا الله كثيرا﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; الذين is excepted (mustathnā) from the blameworthy poets; آمنوا is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. عملوا الصالحات is conjoined to ﴿آمنوا﴾, falling within the scope of the ṣila; ذكروا الله is likewise conjoined; and ﴿كثيرًا﴾ stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is the adjective of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. «ذكروا الله ذكرًا كثيرًا» (they remembered Allah with much remembrance); or it is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted adverb of time, i.e. «وقتًا كثيرًا» (much time).
﴿وانتصروا من بعد ما ظلموا﴾: conjoined to what precedes; انتصروا is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿من بعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿انتصروا﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun-forming); ﴿ظلموا﴾ is a past verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the maṣdariyya ما together with what it introduces is interpreted as a maṣdar, i.e. «من بعد ظلمهم» (after their being wronged), this being an annexation of the maṣdar to its object.
﴿وسيعلم الذين ظلموا أي منقلب ينقلبون﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the sīn is a particle of the future (istiqbāl); يعلم is an imperfect verb, and الذين is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ظلموا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أي﴾ is an interrogative noun standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the word governing it being ﴿ينقلبون﴾; it may not be governed by ﴿يعلم﴾, because the interrogative has the right to the head of the sentence, so what precedes it does not govern it; ﴿منقلب﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿ينقلبون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿ينقلبون﴾ stands in place of the two objects of ﴿يعلم﴾.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿طسم﴾: the discussion of the disjoined letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has already been given at the beginning of Surat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿تلك آيات الكتاب المبين﴾: تلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); آيات الكتاب is the khabar (predicate); and المبين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الكتاب﴾.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿لعلك باخع نفسك ألا يكونوا مؤمنين﴾: لعل is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the kāf is its noun, and باخع is its khabar (predicate); نفسك is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿باخع﴾; أن together with what falls in its scope is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "for fear that they will not believe"; and مؤمنين is the khabar of يكونوا.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿إن نشأ ننزل عليهم من السماء آية فظلت أعناقهم لها خاضعين﴾: إن is conditional; نشأ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent, its implied form being "نحن"; the object of the willing is omitted, i.e. "their faith"; ننزل is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ننزل﴾; ﴿من السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿آية﴾; the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ظلت is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb conjoined to ننزل, in the position of the jussive; or the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; أعناقهم is the noun of ظلت; ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خاضعين﴾; and خاضعين is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿ظلت﴾.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿وما يأتيهم من ذكر من الرحمن محدث إلا كانوا عنه معرضين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; يأتيهم is an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ذكر is the fāʿil (agent), genitive in form and nominative in position; ﴿من الرحمن﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ذكر﴾, and محدث is a second naʿt; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is an exception from the most general of states, so it is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and the wāw of the plural is its noun; ﴿عنه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿معرضين﴾; and معرضين is the khabar (predicate) of كان.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿فقد كذبوا﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); كذبوا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿فسيأتيهم أنباء ما كانوا به يستهزئون﴾: conjoined to what precedes; يأتيهم is an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أنباء is the fāʿil; ﴿ما﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; the wāw is the noun of كان; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستهزئون﴾; and the clause يستهزئون is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿أولم يروا إلى الأرض كم أنبتنا فيها من كل زوج كريم﴾: the hamza is interrogative; the wāw conjoins to something implied; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يروا is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يروا﴾; كم is declarative (khabariyya), in the position of the accusative as the object of ﴿أنبتنا﴾; أنبتنا is a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿من كل زوج﴾ is the tamyīz (specification) of the declarative كم; and كريم is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿زوج﴾.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿إن في ذلك لآية﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿في ذلك﴾ is its fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and آية is the noun of إن.
﴿وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating; ﴿كان أكثرهم مؤمنين﴾: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, أكثرهم is its noun and مؤمنين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿وإن ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ﴿رب﴾ is its noun and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿هو﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and العزيز is the khabar (predicate) of إن; or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), العزيز is the khabar of ﴿هو﴾, and the clause is the khabar of إن; and الرحيم is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t: ﴿وإذ نادى ربك موسى أن ائت القوم الظالمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being "واذكر إذ نادى ربك"; the clause ﴿نادى﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ربك is the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿نادى﴾, and موسى is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿أن ائت﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, which together with what it enters upon is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نادى﴾. The clause ﴿ائت القوم﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾ and has no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. ﴿ائت﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنت". القوم: a mafʿūl bihi. الظالمين: a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿قوم فرعون ألا يتقون﴾: ﴿قوم فرعون﴾ is a badal (substitute) from ﴿القوم الظالمين﴾, or a ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the hamza is interrogative and لا is negating; يتقون is a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿ألا يتقون﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. It has been said: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun carried by the active participle, namely الظالمون, i.e. "they do wrong, not being God-fearing". And it has been said: ﴿ألا﴾ is for proposal (ʿarḍ) or for drawing attention (tanbīh).

muyesser-irab:12-12.t: ﴿قال رب إني أخاف أن يكذبون﴾: قال is a past verb; رب is an annexed (muḍāf) one addressed (munādā) from which the vocative particle has been omitted; ﴿إنى﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause أخاف is its khabar (predicate); and أن together with what falls in its scope is the object of أخاف.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t: ﴿ويضيق صدري ولا ينطلق لساني فأرسل إلى هارون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يضيق is a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, and صدري is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿لا ينطلق لساني﴾ is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿فأرسل﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and أرسل is an imperative verb; and ﴿إلى هارون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسل﴾.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿ولهم علي ذنب فأخاف أن يقتلون﴾: conjoined to what precedes; ﴿لهم﴾: the lām is a preposition and ﴿هم﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿علي﴾: على is a preposition and the yāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ذنب is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), on the assumption that a muḍāf has been omitted, i.e. "the consequence of a sin". [Translator's note: the source does not parse فأخاف أن يقتلون here.]

muyesser-irab:15-15.t: ﴿قال كلا فاذهبا بآياتنا إنا معكم مستمعون﴾: كلا is a particle of rebuke and deterrence; فاذهبا is an imperative verb, and the alif of the dual is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿بآياتنا﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, آيات is a genitive noun, and ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اذهبا﴾; the clause ﴿إنا معكم مستمعون﴾ gives the reason for the command; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and مستمعون is its khabar (predicate); the wāw is the fāʿil of ﴿مستمعون﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the wāw of مستمعون is the plural ending, and the participle's agent is a latent pronoun], and the object is omitted, i.e. "what passes between the two of you and Pharaoh"; and ﴿معكم﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or a second khabar, or attached to ﴿مستمعون﴾.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿فأتيا فرعون فقولا إنا رسول رب العالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ائتيا فرعون [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic text reads فأتيا] is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فقولا﴾ is conjoined, and it is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; ﴿إنا﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; رسول is its khabar (predicate); and ﴿رب العالمين﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿أن﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. It has also been said that ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar).
﴿أرسل﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent.
﴿معنا﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسل﴾.
﴿بني﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إسرائيل﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t: ﴿قال ألم نربك فينا وليدا ولبثت فينا من عمرك سنين﴾: قال is a past verb; ألم نربك: the hamza is interrogative, لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive, and نربك is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن", and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فينا﴾: ﴿في﴾ is a preposition and ﴿نا﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نربك﴾; وليدًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); لبثت is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿فينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿لبثت﴾; ﴿من عمرك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was a naʿt (adjective) of سنين; and سنين is an adverb, also attached to ﴿لبثت﴾.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿وفعلت فعلتك التي فعلت وأنت من الكافرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿فعلت﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿فعلتك﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿التي﴾ is a naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿فعلت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾ and has no grammatical position; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); أنت is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من الكافرين﴾: من is a preposition and ﴿الكافرين﴾ is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿قال فعلتها إذا﴾: ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb; ﴿فعلتها﴾ is a past verb, the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿إذًا﴾ is a particle of requital (jazāʾ), serving as an answer.
﴿وأنا من الضالين﴾: the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl (circumstance); أنا is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من﴾ is a preposition and الضالين a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿أنا من الضالين﴾ is a circumstantial (ḥāliyya) clause.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿ففررت منكم لما خفتكم فوهب لي ربي حكما وجعلني من المرسلين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; فررت is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿منكم﴾: من is a preposition and the kāf is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فررت﴾; لما is temporal (ḥīniyya, "when") or linking (rābiṭa); ﴿خفتكم﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and an object, and the clause ﴿خفتكم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; فوهب is conjoined to ففررت; ﴿لي﴾: the lām is a preposition and the yāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿وهب﴾; ربي is the fāʿil, and حكمًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿جعلني من المرسلين﴾ is conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t: ﴿وتلك نعمة تمنها علي أن عبدت بني إسرائيل﴾: تلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and نعمة is the khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿تمنها﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of نعمة; ﴿علي﴾: على is a preposition and the yāʾ is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تمنها﴾; أن together with what falls in its scope is a ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of ﴿تلك﴾, or a badal (substitute) from ﴿نعمة﴾, or in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); تمنها is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت"; the hāʾ is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "you remind me of it (تمن بها)"; ﴿عبدت﴾ is a past verb and the tāʾ is the fāʿil; and ﴿بني إسرائيل﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the yāʾ.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t: ﴿قال فرعون وما رب العالمين﴾: ﴿قال فرعون﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun and a mubtadaʾ (subject), and رب العالمين is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿قال رب السماوات والأرض وما بينهما إن كنتم موقنين﴾: قال is a past verb; ﴿رب﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); ما is conjoined to ﴿السماوات والأرض﴾; ﴿بينهما﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; إن is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ is its noun and موقنين is its khabar; and the apodosis of إن is omitted, i.e. "if you are among those from whom sound reflection and proper consideration are hoped for, this answer will benefit you".

muyesser-irab:25-25.t: ﴿قال لمن حوله ألا تستمعون﴾: ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent, its implied form being "هو"; ﴿لمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; حوله: an adverb attached to something omitted that is the ṣila of the relative, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The hamza is interrogative, لا is negating, and تستمعون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿قال ربكم ورب آبائكم الأولين﴾: ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb and the fāʿil (agent) is latent, its implied form being "هو"; ﴿ربكم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "هو"; رب آبائكم is conjoined to ربكم; and الأولين is a naʿt (adjective) of آبائكم.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿قال إن رسولكم الذي أرسل إليكم لمجنون﴾: قال is a past verb; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, رسول is its noun and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. الذي: a naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿أرسل إليكم﴾: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position. The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and مجنون is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and the clause إن رسولكم is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t: ﴿قال رب المشرق والمغرب وما بينهما إن كنتم تعقلون﴾: قال is a past verb; ﴿رب﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) [Translator's note: so in the source; in the parallel entry on 26:24 رب is analysed as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, and no khabar is given for رب here]; ﴿المشرق﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿المغرب﴾ is conjoined to المشرق; ﴿ما﴾ is likewise conjoined; ﴿بينهما﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. ﴿إن كنتم تعقلون﴾ is a condition, and its apodosis (jawāb) is omitted.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t: ﴿قال لئن اتخذت إلها غيري لأجعلنك من المسجونين﴾: قال is a past verb; ﴿لئن﴾: the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and إن is conditional; اتخذت is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the verb is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); إلهًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and غيري is a naʿt (adjective); the lām is [that of] the answer to the oath, and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath; أجعلنك is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا"; and ﴿من المسجونين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿قال أولو جئتك بشيء مبين﴾: قال is a past verb; the hamza is interrogative, the wāw is circumstantial (for ḥāl), and لو is conditional; جئتك is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بشيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جئتك﴾; and مبين is a naʿt (adjective) of شيء.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t: ﴿قال فأت به إن كنت من الصادقين﴾: قال is a past verb; ﴿فائت﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) His word ﴿فائت﴾; إن is conditional; ﴿كنت﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and the tāʾ is its noun; ﴿من الصادقين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of كان; and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t: ﴿فألقى عصاه فإذا هي ثعبان مبين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ألقى is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent, its implied form being "هو"; عصاه is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and it is an adverb or a particle; ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), ثعبان is the khabar (predicate), and مبين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿ونزع يده فإذا هي بيضاء للناظرين﴾: the clause is conjoined to the one before it; نزع is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent, its implied form being "هو"; ﴿يده﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and it is an adverb or a particle; ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and بيضاء is the khabar (predicate); and ﴿للناظرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿قال للملأ حوله إن هذا لساحر عليم﴾: قال is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) [Translator's note: so in the source; قال here has no wāw, and its agent is a latent pronoun referring to Pharaoh]; ﴿للملأ﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; حوله is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ﴿هذا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ساحر is the khabar (predicate) and عليم a second khabar; and the clause ﴿إن هذا لساحر...﴾ is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿يريد أن يخرجكم من أرضكم بسحره﴾: the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ساحر﴾; أن together with what falls in its scope is the object of يريد; ﴿من أرضكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يخرجكم﴾; and ﴿بسحره﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يخرجكم﴾.
﴿فماذا تأمرون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿ماذا﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the second object of تأمرون, with the preposition dropped, and the first object is omitted, the implied form being: "with what thing do you command me (بأي شيء تأمرونني)?"; the clause ﴿تأمرون﴾ is conjoined to the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). Or: ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun and a mubtadaʾ (subject), ﴿ذا﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate), the clause ﴿تأمرون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative with no grammatical position, and the referring pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, the implied form being: "so what is it that you command me (فما الذي تأمروننيه)?"; and the clause ﴿ماذا تأمرون﴾ is conjoined to the object of the speech.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿قالوا أرجه وأخاه وابعث في المدائن حاشرين﴾: قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); أرجه is an imperative verb, and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أخاه is conjoined to the hāʾ, or it is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); ابعث is conjoined to أرجه; ﴿في المدائن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ابعث﴾; and حاشرين is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "soldiers who will gather the sorcerers and assemble them".

muyesser-irab:37-37.t: ﴿يأتوك بكل سحار عليم﴾: يأتوك is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بكل سحار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأتوك﴾; and عليم is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سحار﴾.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿فجمع السحرة لميقات يوم معلوم﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something implied; جمع is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); السحرة is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿لميقات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جمع﴾; يوم is muḍāf ilayhi; and معلوم is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وقيل للناس هل أنتم مجتمعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿قيل﴾ is conjoined to what precedes; ﴿للناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قيل﴾; ﴿هل﴾ is an interrogative particle; أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and مجتمعون is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿لعلنا نتبع السحرة إن كانوا هم الغالبين﴾: the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); لعل is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿نتبع﴾ is its khabar (predicate); السحرة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إن is conditional; ﴿كانوا﴾: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw of the plural is its noun; ﴿هم﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); and الغالبين is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿فلما جاء السحرة قالوا لفرعون أئن لنا لأجرا إن كنا نحن الغالبين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is a temporal adverb (ḥīniyya, "when") or linking (rābiṭa); جاء السحرة is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; ﴿لفرعون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قالوا﴾; the hamza is interrogative; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted, fronted khabar (predicate), and أجرًا is its postponed noun; إن is conditional; ﴿كنا﴾: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿نحن﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); الغالبين is the khabar of ﴿كان﴾; and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿قال نعم وإنكم إذا لمن المقربين﴾: قال is a past verb; ﴿نعم﴾ is a particle of answer, i.e. "you shall have the wage"; وإنكم is conjoined; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and the kāf is its noun; ﴿إذًا﴾ is a particle of answer and requital (jazāʾ); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and ﴿من المقربين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿قال لهم موسى ألقوا ما أنتم ملقون﴾: قال لهم موسى is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; the clause ألقوا is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أنتم ملقون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative and has no grammatical position; أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ملقون is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿فألقوا حبالهم وعصيهم وقالوا بعزة فرعون إنا لنحن الغالبون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ألقوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); حبالهم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ﴿عصيهم﴾ is conjoined to حبالهم; ﴿قالوا﴾ is conjoined to فألقوا; ﴿بعزة﴾: the bāʾ is a particle of oath and a preposition, and عزة is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "نقسم"; ﴿إنا﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); نحن is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and الغالبون is the khabar (predicate) of إن; or ﴿نحن﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), الغالبون is the khabar of ﴿نحن﴾, and the clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿فألقى موسى عصاه فإذا هي تلقف ما يأفكون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ألقى موسى عصاه is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause تلقف is the khabar (predicate); ﴿ما﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause يأفكون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿فألقي السحرة ساجدين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ألقي is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); السحرة is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and ساجدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t: ﴿قالوا آمنا برب العالمين﴾: قالوا is a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause آمنا, made of the verb and the fāʿil, is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿برب العالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنا﴾; and the clause of saying is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from ﴿ألقي﴾, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) with قد implied.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿رب موسى وهارون﴾: رب is a badal (substitute) from رب العالمين, or a ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); موسى is muḍāf ilayhi, and هارون is conjoined.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿قال آمنتم له قبل أن آذن لكم﴾: قال is a past verb; the clause آمنتم is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنتم﴾; the adverb is attached to ﴿آمنتم﴾; أن together with what falls in its scope is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿آذن﴾.
﴿إنه لكبيركم الذي علمكم السحر فلسوف تعلمون﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and the hāʾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); كبيركم is the khabar (predicate) of إن; الذي is a naʿt (adjective); the clause علمكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative and has no grammatical position; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and السحر the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿فلسوف﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath, and سوف is a particle of futurity; تعلمون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the object is omitted.
﴿لأقطعن أيديكم وأرجلكم من خلاف ولأصلبنكم أجمعين﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath. أقطعن: an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". أيديكم: a mafʿūl bihi. أرجلكم: conjoined to أيديكم. ﴿من خلاف﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). لأصلبنكم: conjoined to لأقطعن. أجمعين: a tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿قالوا لا ضير إنا إلى ربنا منقلبون﴾: قالوا is a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); لا is the lā of generic negation; ﴿ضير﴾ is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "no harm upon us"; the clause ﴿إنا﴾ gives the reason; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; ﴿إلى ربنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿منقلبون﴾; and منقلبون is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿إنا نطمع أن يغفر لنا ربنا خطايانا﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause نطمع is its khabar (predicate); the fāʿil (agent) is latent, its implied form being "نحن"; أن together with what falls in its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "in the forgiving of our sins" — or, on the view that ﴿نطمع﴾ is made to carry the sense of "we hope", ﴿أن﴾ together with what falls in its scope is in the position of the accusative as an object; ﴿ربنا﴾ is the fāʿil of يغفر, and خطايانا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أن كنا أول المؤمنين﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن كنا﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "because we were"; ﴿كنا﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and أول المؤمنين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿وأوحينا إلى موسى أن أسر بعبادي إنكم متبعون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; أوحينا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); إلى موسى: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحينا﴾. ﴿أن﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya), because revelation contains the meaning of saying without its letters, and the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, and together with what it enters upon it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أوحى﴾; the clause ﴿أسر﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾ and has no grammatical position. أسر: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is latent. بعبادي: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أسر﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "accompanied by My servants". ﴿إنكم متبعون﴾: إن, its noun and its khabar (predicate). The clause of ﴿إن﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya) and resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t: ﴿فأرسل فرعون في المدائن حاشرين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أرسل فرعون is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿في المدائن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and حاشرين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿إن هؤلاء لشرذمة قليلون﴾: the clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying, which is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "saying"; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and هؤلاء is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); شرذمة is its khabar (predicate), and قليلون is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿وإنهم لنا لغائظون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿غائظون﴾; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and غائظون is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿وإنا لجميع حاذرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); جميع is the first khabar (predicate) and حاذرون the second khabar.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿فأخرجناهم من جنات وعيون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿أخرجناهم﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿من جنات وعيون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخرجناهم﴾.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿وكنوز ومقام كريم﴾: ﴿وكنوز ومقام﴾ is conjoined to ﴿جنات وعيون﴾, and كريم is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿كذلك وأورثناها بني إسرائيل﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of مثل, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "We expelled them with an expulsion like that"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām indicates distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿أورثناها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or parenthetical; أورثناها: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بني: the second mafʿūl bihi; إسرائيل: muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿أورثناها...﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أخرجناهم﴾, or parenthetical with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿فأتبعوهم مشرقين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أتبعوهم is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Translator's note: so in the source, «second object»]; and مشرقين is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿فلما تراءى الجمعان قال أصحاب موسى إنا لمدركون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is a temporal adverb (ḥīniyya, "when") or linking (rābiṭa); تراءى الجمعان is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿قال﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer of ﴿لما﴾; أصحاب is the fāʿil of قال; and the clause إنا لمدركون is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t: ﴿قال كلا إن معي ربي سيهدين﴾: قال is a past verb; ﴿كلا﴾ is a particle of deterrence and rebuke; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate), and ربي is its postponed noun; ﴿إن معي﴾ gives the reason for this deterrence; and the clause سيهدين is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿فأوحينا إلى موسى أن اضرب بعصاك البحر فانفلق﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أوحينا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى موسى﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحينا﴾. ﴿أن﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya), because revelation contains the meaning of saying without its letters, and the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, and together with what it enters upon it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أوحى﴾; the clause ﴿اضرب﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾ and has no grammatical position. ﴿اضرب بعصاك البحر﴾: an imperative verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بعصاك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اضرب﴾. ﴿فانفلق﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), i.e. "so he struck, and it split".
﴿فكان كل فرق كالطود العظيم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, كل is its noun, and ﴿فرق﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿كالطود﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of مثل, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كان, and ﴿الطود﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿العظيم﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of الطود.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t: ﴿وأزلفنا ثم الآخرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أزلفنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ثم is an adverb in the sense of "there" (هناك); and الآخرين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:65-65.t: ﴿وأنجينا موسى ومن معه أجمعين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنجينا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and it is conjoined to what precedes; موسى is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); مَن is conjoined to موسى; ﴿معه﴾ is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause) of مَن, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis) of ﴿مَن﴾.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿ثم أغرقنا الآخرين﴾: conjoined to what precedes; أغرقنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and الآخرين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿إن في ذلك لآية وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of إن; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آية is the noun of إن, accusative (manṣūb); the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, أكثرهم is its noun, and مؤمنين is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿وإن ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم﴾: conjoined to what precedes; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and ربك is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿هو﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and العزيز الرحيم are two khabars (predicates) of ﴿إن﴾; or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), العزيز الرحيم are two khabars of ﴿هو﴾, and the clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿واتل عليهم نبأ إبراهيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتل is conjoined to the implied اذكر in His words ﴿وإذ نادى ربك موسى﴾; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اتل﴾; and نبأ إبراهيم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿إذ قال لأبيه وقومه ما تعبدون﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نبأ﴾, or a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn in the position of the accusative as a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from ﴿نبأ﴾; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿لأبيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قال﴾; قومه is conjoined; ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) fronted before ﴿تعبدون﴾; and the clause ما تعبدون is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:71-71.t: ﴿قالوا نعبد أصناما فنظل لها عاكفين﴾: قالوا is a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause نعبد أصنامًا is in the position of the accusative as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿فنظل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and نظل is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating (nāsikh) imperfect verb whose noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن"; ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عاكفين﴾; and عاكفين is the khabar (predicate) of نظل.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t: ﴿قال هل يسمعونكم إذ تدعون﴾: قال is a past verb; هل is an interrogative particle; يسمعونكم is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), on the assumption of something omitted, i.e. "do they hear your supplication", or "do they hear you as you call"; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسمعونكم﴾; تدعون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; and the clause تدعون is genitive through the adverb being annexed to it.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿أو ينفعونكم أو يضرون﴾: conjoined to يسمعونكم; ينفعونكم is an imperfect verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and يضرون is the same.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t: ﴿قالوا بل وجدنا آباءنا كذلك يفعلون﴾: قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿بل﴾ is for digression (iḍrāb); وجدنا is a verb and its fāʿil; آباءنا is the first object of ﴿وجدنا﴾, and the clause يفعلون is the second object; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of مثل, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "they do a doing like that", or it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) fronted before ﴿يفعلون﴾; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām indicates distance, and the kāf is a particle of address.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t: ﴿قال أفرأيتم ما كنتم تعبدون﴾: قال is a past verb; the hamza is interrogative, and the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted; the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position. The clause تعبدون is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t: ﴿أنتم وآباؤكم الأقدمون﴾: أنتم is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun in ﴿تعبدون﴾; آباؤكم is conjoined to ﴿أنتم﴾; and الأقدمون is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿آباؤكم﴾.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t: ﴿فإنهم عدو لي إلا رب العالمين﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and عدو is its khabar (predicate); ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عدو﴾; إلا is a particle of exception; ﴿رب﴾ is accusative by exception, and the exception is disjoined (munqaṭiʿ); and العالمين is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿الذي خلقني﴾: الذي is accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رب العالمين﴾, or a badal (substitute), or a ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); or nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "He is the One who created me"; and it has been said: it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause ﴿هو يهدين﴾.
﴿فهو يهدين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause يهدين is its khabar; the yāʾ has been dropped out of regard for the verse endings (fawāṣil).

muyesser-irab:79-79.t: ﴿والذي هو يطعمني ويسقين﴾: conjoined to what precedes; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause يطعمني is the khabar (predicate), and يسقين is conjoined to يطعمني.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t: ﴿وإذا مرضت فهو يشفين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يشفين﴾; مرضت is a verb and its fāʿil (agent). The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يشفين is its khabar (predicate); the yāʾ has been dropped out of regard for the verse endings (fawāṣil).

muyesser-irab:81-81.t: ﴿والذي يميتني ثم يحيين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿الذي﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يميتني﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative and has no grammatical position. ﴿ثم يحيين﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يميتني﴾.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t: ﴿والذي أطمع أن يغفر لي خطيئتي يوم الدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الذي is conjoined to what precedes it; the clause أطمع is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative and has no grammatical position. أن together with what falls in its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "for (في) His forgiving"; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يغفر﴾; خطيئتي is the object of يغفر; and يوم الدين is an adverb, also attached to ﴿يغفر﴾.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t: ﴿رب هب لي حكما وألحقني بالصالحين﴾: رب is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person yāʾ, from which the vocative particle has been omitted; ﴿هب﴾ is a verb of supplication (duʿāʾ) indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿هب﴾; حكمًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ألحقني is a verb of supplication indeclinable on sukūn, conjoined to ﴿هب﴾, and the yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿بالصالحين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ألحقني﴾.
